title: AAV fonds 'Ufficio Cifra' (Segreteria di Stato), 20th century
note: Named in the AAV 'Indice dei Fondi' PDF (the only online AAV finding aid, series level). Cipher office records; no item-level description online, access archive only. Candidate route for 20th-c. Vatican cipher traffic; nothing to score.

title: Barb. lat. 9845 f. 50r (Giuseppe di Gesu Maria, Genoa 20 Jan 1652) and Barb. lat. 9812 f. 76r (Gavotti, Mentone 2 Sep 1634)
note: OPAC summaries only: a request for the diplomatic cipher of Card. Antonio Barberini, and a return of 'istruzioni e cifre diplomatiche' to Card. Francesco Barberini. Mentions of ciphers, no ciphertext; 9812 is undigitised. Context for the Barberini keys in Barb. lat. 9914-9915.

title: Cappon. 281 pt. 1 f. 117r, G. R. Volpi to A. G. Capponi, 24 Apr 1739
note: Incipit 'La cifra inviatami e simile a quella': a letter about a cipher, not enciphered; hints at a cipher exchange between Volpi and Capponi (Collegio Greco, Rome).

title: Corsini 188, 190, 193 (Lincei e Corsiniana): minutes and letters collected by mons. Alamanni 'segretario della Cifra' under Clement XI (Unigenitus papers)
shelfmark: Rome, Corsiniana, Cors. 188 (41 D 12), 190 (41 D 8), 193 (41 D 11)
note: Manus 'cifra' hits are the post title 'segretario della Cifra'; clear drafts of briefs. Not cipher text. Recorded so nobody re-opens them.
